info.name: Finanzas - Taller 4 REST JWT
info.description: Ejecutar completa en orden con el entorno demo. Crea datos propios y los elimina al terminar.

exec: pm.environment.set("runId", Date.now().toString()); pm.environment.set("testCode", "T" + String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.floor(Math.random()*26)) + String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.floor(Math.random()*26)));

const d=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("adminToken",d.accessToken); pm.test("Roles y expiracion",()=>{ if(d.tokenType!=="Bearer" || !d.roles.includes("ROLE_ADMINISTRADOR") || new Date(d.expiresAt)<=new Date(d.issuedAt)) throw Error("JWT incompleto"); });
const d=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("userId",d.id); pm.test("Sin contrasena",()=>{if(d.passwordHash || d.password) throw Error("Contrasena expuesta");});
pm.test("Saldo pendiente 800",()=>{if(pm.response.json().saldoPendiente!==800) throw Error("Transaccion no revertida");});

item.name: Invitado no accede a cuenta ajena

exec: const d=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("registeredId",d.id); pm.test("Sin privilegios",()=>{if(d.rolIds.length!==1 || String(d.rolIds[0])!==String(pm.environment.get("baseRoleId"))) throw Error("Registro privilegiado");});
